findings.summary: The 1x1 fast path in the shared _ConvNd.get_delta_weight is 2D-only: for Conv3d with kernel (1,1,1) it produces a 4D delta instead of 5D, and for kernel (1,1,k) it is wrongly taken and squeezes the wrong dimensions, so merging fails or broadcasts incorrectly.

self.conv_fn is set in the Conv2d/Conv3d subclass __init__ only after super().__init__() has already run update_layer, so anything in update_layer that reaches get_delta_weight or conv_fn (e.g. LoftQ/PiSSA init) raises AttributeError.
The new Conv3d.__init__ error message wrongly says "Conv2d layer kernel must have 5 dimensions" instead of Conv3d.
